findings: Guide describes live-side deaths producing undead-side enemies and emphasizes communication so live-side killing does not overrun the other group.

excerpts.fissure-guide-delay: After 3 seconds, it explodes and deals 62,000 shadow damage

findings: Phase-one sections distinguish the three add types and separate melee tanked-add work from ranged interception of approaching enemies.

Body supplies Shadow Fissure delay/damage and Frost Blast health-fraction claims. The latter corroborates one branch of the original conflict, but neither percentage becomes a threshold or grade without raw evidence.
The introduction ties phase change to clearing the portal mobs, while the original ledger supplies an elapsed full-pull timer. Do not infer a selected logged fight starts at that full-pull origin.
The guide itself combines Nature-protection preparation with an Arcane Detonate Mana description. That inconsistency is retained, not repaired from comments.
